title_en: What RL on Expert-Built Tasks Teaches Nemotron 3.5 Super
title_zh: Nemotron 3.5 Super 的专家任务强化学习实践
summary_en: NVIDIA post-trains Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active) with reinforcement learning on five expert-built task datasets: software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, chart understanding, and document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter using CISPO on Tinker without supervised stages, and adapters are compared to the base model on identical tasks. On twelve benchmarks, gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf (10.4% to 24.2%); SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5%, and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationBench. Analysis shows each adapter addresses specific failure modes of the base model, such as finding data and rules before acting, writing test files, carrying context, measuring marks in code, and reading spreadsheets.
summary_zh: NVIDIA 对 Nemotron 3.5 Super（总参数 120B，激活参数 12B）进行强化学习后训练，使用五个专家构建的任务数据集：真实软件工程、复杂约束、长视野工具使用、专业图表理解和文档推理。每次训练使用 CISPO 在 Tinker 上训练新的 rank-32 LoRA 适配器，无监督阶段，并在相同任务、测试框架和设置下与基础模型比较。在十二个基准测试中，增益从 IFBench 的 +4.5 分到 GDP_pdf 的 +13.8 分（10.4% 升至 24.2%）；SWE-bench Pro V2 从 86.9% 升至 92.1%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 63.9% 升至 70.3%，MultiChallenge 从 58.3% 升至 66.6%，AutomationBench 从 14.8% 升至 27.5%，Chartography 从 39.4% 升至 50.6%。文档适配器虽未使用 API 工具训练，但在 AutomationBench 上仍获得 +8.0 分。分析表明，每个适配器针对基础模型的具体失败模式进行改进，例如先查找数据和规则再行动、编写测试文件、携带上下文、用代码测量标记以及读取电子表格。
content_en: We post-train NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active parameters) with reinforcement learning (RL) on five expert-built task datasets, one at a time: real-world software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, professional chart understanding and enterprise document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter with CISPO on Tinker, with no supervised stage, and each adapter is compared with the base model on the same tasks, harness and settings. On twelve headline benchmarks, eight built by other groups and four by Surge AI, the gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf, which rises from 10.4% to 24.2%; SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5% and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationBench. In attempts read side by side with the base model's on tasks each adapter newly solves, the base model's failures recur in a few modes, and each adapter does more often what the base model missed: the tool-use adapter finds the data and the rules before acting, the coding adapter writes its own test or scratch files on SWE-bench Pro V2, the constraints adapter carries earlier turns into its answers, the chart adapter measures the marks in code, and the document adapter reads AutomationBench's spreadsheets.
content_zh: 我们在五个由专家构建的任务数据集上，对 NVIDIA 的 Nemotron 3.5 Super（总参数 120B，激活参数 12B）逐个进行强化学习（RL）后训练：真实世界软件工程、复杂约束、长程工具使用、专业图表理解和企文档推理。每次运行都在 Tinker 上使用 CISPO 训练一个全新的 rank-32 LoRA 适配器，不设监督阶段，并将每个适配器与基座模型在相同任务、测试框架和设置下进行比较。在十二个头条基准上（八个由其他团队构建，四个由 Surge AI 构建），提升幅度从 IFBench 的 +4.5 分到 GDP_pdf 的 +13.8 分不等，后者从 10.4% 升至 24.2%；SWE-bench Pro V2 从 86.9% 升至 92.1%，Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 63.9% 升至 70.3%，MultiChallenge 从 58.3% 升至 66.6%，AutomationBench 从 14.8% 升至 27.5%，Chartography 从 39.4% 升至 50.6%。文档适配器在未使用 API 工具训练的情况下，在 AutomationBench 上也获得了 +8.0 分的提升。在将各适配器新解决的任务与基座模型的尝试并排阅读时，基座模型的失败反复呈现为几种模式，而每个适配器都更频繁地做到了基座模型遗漏的事情：工具使用适配器在行动前先找到数据和规则，编码适配器在 SWE-bench Pro V2 上编写自己的测试或临时文件，约束适配器将较早的轮次带入其回答，图表适配器在代码中测量标记，文档适配器读取 AutomationBench 的电子表格。
